title: A reptilian being appears in Barbara Lamb's living room

tellings.quote: then one afternoon she she came out of her garden into her house and here was this reptilian guy

plain: A woman named Barbara Lamb came in from her garden one afternoon in the 2020s and found a reptilian being standing in her house, according to the guest Dan Sheehan. Sheehan tells Michels what Lamb told him, putting her alongside the work of John Mack and pointing to an archive of recordings of her sessions. It is told as a sign that such beings can turn up in an ordinary home.
